description: Unified interaction classification for all 27 A4 capabilities. CORRECTED 2026-09-18 by gmi-833-capability-interaction-partition-v1: the shipped classification was assigned from shared resource channels alone and contradicted the theorem's own Section 1.2 burden definitions on 56 of 351 pairs; Section 1.2 itself did not partition (287 of 351).
theorem: CI-U (universal claim-structure classification; Lemma A/B/C) + Corollary CI-A4 (registered 27x27 instance)
scope: All 27 capabilities from the 27-row A4 contract, pairwise interaction. The class is determined by the BURDEN triple (max, joint, sum), not by channel overlap; the decisive channel-level invariant is NESTING. Corrected census: INDEPENDENT 8, REDUNDANT 287, PARTIAL_SHARING 56, INTERFERING 0 (351 unordered pairs).
falsifier: An A4 pair with joint > sum under union accounting; a pair with no shared channels that is not INDEPENDENT; a pair with nested nonempty channel sets that is not REDUNDANT; a pair with intersecting non-nested channel sets that is not PARTIAL_SHARING; an admissible burden triple landing in zero or in two or more of the four CIP-1 classes.

audit_trail.finding: #939 verdict table: OVERSTRONG — the universal phrasing "for any two capabilities" exceeds a pure 27x27 finite classification once the rules rest on unproven equalities (joint=sum / joint=max).
audit_trail.intermediate_state: applied downgrade to 27x27 finite scope (commit b2b5a9d9) — superseded as closure by the operator revival doctrine ("aim for the best claim, not downgrading and narrowing").
revival_chain: DIAGNOSE: the equalities hide two real premises — (i) within-channel claim shareability (joint=max fails for disjoint claims in one channel), (ii) free-option accounting (no-interference fails under mandatory upkeep). Not proof convenience: each has a concrete counterexample.
LEVER: add the missing mechanism — per-channel claim-SET structure Q_X(c); channel-wise accounting B(A) = sum_c |union of claims|.

RE-PROVE AT ORIGINAL STRENGTH: Theorem CI-U — Lemma A (disjoint => joint=sum, unconditional), Lemma B (shared-channel max<=joint<=sum with EXACT equality characterization: nested<=>max, disjoint<=>sum, partial<=>between, unconditional), Lemma C (free-option monotonicity by feasible-set inclusion). Corollary CI-A4: the 27x27 classification is the fully-shareable registered instance.

BOUNDARY: unconditional joint=max refuted by CE-1 (episodic vs semantic disjoint stores in channel S); unconditional no-interference refuted by CE-2 (mandatory upkeep). Both EARNED-BY-COUNTEREXAMPLE, complete obstruction list.
audit_trail.universal_claim_status: RESTORED AND EARNED (strongest true claim: universal bounds + exact characterization + premise-indexed no-interference); the finite 27x27 remains the registered instance
